script_text:
Pisces, Neptune's currents are about to clash with Jupiter's expansion, stirring hidden passions.

Monday brings Mercury trine Neptune in your 9th House, travel ideas and a boost for creative plans. Tuesday's Mars square Neptune in your 1st House dulls confidence, your worst day for presentations. Wednesday's Venus sextile Pluto in your 7th House sparks love‑magnetizing surge.

On Thursday Jupiter stations direct at 12° Aries, ending a three‑month retrograde and lifting your 10th House career.

Friday's Saturn conjunct Mercury in your 5th House grounds artistic pursuits into earnings, Saturday's Sun trine Neptune in the 12th House eases stress and enhances spiritual insight.

Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House, igniting romance. Tuesday is your challenge due to the Mars‑Neptune square, straining confidence and causing work friction.

Write one dream journal entry each night to harness Neptune's Water‑element creativity.

Follow for daily updates.
